note: City of Blue Earth campground inside the Faribault County Fairgrounds, open all season, not just fair week; ball fields, a playground and the paved Unity Trail start there. Tent camping is single-night only, one tent a site. --Claude
summary: City page read: 14 full-hookup 50/30-amp sites, $35 a night with WiFi and firewood, May 1 - Oct 1, showers, dump station, reservations by phone/email. Not 'reservable online' as the old note said. Not waterfront confirmed.
